scope: Existing staging testnet. Frozen baseline and candidate SDK assets served only to the test browser. All thirteen backend versions stayed unchanged. No deployment, activation, new resource, or package publication.
method: Sequential baseline/candidate/baseline. Three fresh NEAR-only wallets and twenty-one verified signatures per arm. The candidate removes the NEAR owner-lane preflight. Local exact-material checks remain. Prepare and finalize still check live authority, active material, policy and operation admission.
decision: Keep the redundant-request removal. Repeated signing makes two Gateway requests instead of three. Lane-preparation timing isolates the removed wait; whole-signing medians also include network and confirmation variation.

e2e.command: Build the candidate SDK and local Gateway; run passkey.ed25519-yao-local.contract.test.ts with the NEAR observation/quota/reload, changed-prepare-authority, retired-session/fresh-unlock, and ECDSA lost-response/add-signer lifecycle checks.

regionalVerification.scope: The composed regional scenario completed NEAR quota step-up, then timed out at the ECDSA confirmation. Two candidate runs and the unchanged baseline reproduce this failure. No production behavior was changed for it.

limitations: Three candidate wallets. Sequential samples do not establish a percentile or a guaranteed whole-flow saving.
The composed regional budget test has an unresolved ECDSA confirmation timeout on both baseline and candidate. NEAR step-up passed in those runs. The separate local ECDSA lifecycle passed.
sdkSigningMs spans SDK invocation through signed output and includes automated confirmation, required nonce/RPC work, and MPC. It excludes blockchain transaction submission and confirmation.
elapsedToVerifiedMs also includes browser interaction and verification overhead. Registration includes funding and provisioning. Unlock includes the unlock lifecycle.
signature_total measures prepare, client share creation and finalize. It excludes the earlier lane and session reads, so this change does not directly reduce that metric.
Request counts cover Gateway POST requests overlapping each browser workload. Registration and unlock counts can include background work.
D1 counters and Gateway-to-Console counters were unavailable. Null does not mean zero. Browser-to-Console requests were zero.

No Yao protocol, DO initialization, placement or deployed backend change was made. The removed Gateway endpoint branch was verified locally with the matching candidate server. Registration setup variation is not an optimization result.

Local E2Es cover quota exhaustion, page refresh, changed prepare authority, session retirement and subsequent unlock/signing. ECDSA signing retains its existing preflight. Export keeps the exact authorization reader.

reproduction.build: Public .artifacts/r155b-phase6r/build.py builds baseline and candidate SDKs from source.json. Unchanged WASM artifacts are shared.
reproduction.local: Public .artifacts/r155b-phase6r/test-local.py runs the focused retirement browser check. The initial run retained three passing lifecycle checks. Two initial retirement assertions were corrected after tracing the live authorization rule. Retirement rejects reusable signing and step-up using that session credential. Fresh unlock establishes new authority. A reused local database failed bootstrap before the successful fresh-state retry.
reproduction.hosted: Private .artifacts/r155b-phase6r-hosted/run.py serves each frozen SDK through the existing NEAR-only browser harness, guards versions around every arm, and closes its tails in finally.
